evals.name: drawing-toolbar-active
evals.prompt: Build a vertical drawing toolbar with Select, Draw and Rectangle tools where the chosen tool shows as active, using Cratis Components and react-icons. Show the TSX in your reply and note the import path and what the active prop does for accessibility. Do not write files.
evals.expected_output: Toolbar and ToolbarButton imported from @cratis/components/Toolbar; each ToolbarButton has a required title (tooltip and accessible name) and icon as a React node; active bound to state sets aria-pressed; toolbar named with aria-label.
assertions: Imports from @cratis/components/Toolbar, not the root barrel.
Gives every ToolbarButton a title prop and does not use a tooltip prop on ToolbarButton.
Passes icons as React nodes such as <FaPencil />.
States that supplying active sets aria-pressed, and names the toolbar with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

evals.name: horizontal-zoom-strip
evals.prompt: Make a horizontal zoom strip: zoom out, a button showing the current percent that resets to 100, zoom in, a separator and a Help button. The tooltips currently cover the bar. Give the TSX in your reply; no files.
evals.expected_output: Toolbar orientation='horizontal', ToolbarSeparator with orientation='horizontal', tooltipPosition='bottom' (or top) on buttons, text prop for the percent value, titles on all buttons.
assertions: Sets orientation='horizontal' on Toolbar and the same orientation on ToolbarSeparator.
Sets tooltipPosition to bottom or top on the buttons, since the default is right.
Uses the text prop on the button that displays the zoom percentage.

evals.name: fan-out-and-folder-props
evals.prompt: Add to a toolbar docked on the right screen edge: (a) a Shapes button that fans out Rectangle and Circle, (b) a Tools folder showing Draw and Erase as a list. Which label prop does each component take, and which direction should the fan-out go? Show TSX. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: ToolbarFanOutItem takes required icon and tooltip (the one component whose label is tooltip) with fanOutDirection='left' away from the right edge; ToolbarFolder takes title and icon with mode='list'. Inner buttons use title.
assertions: Uses tooltip, not title, as the label prop on ToolbarFanOutItem and passes the required icon.
Uses title on ToolbarFolder with mode='list'.
Sets fanOutDirection to left so it fans away from the screen edge the toolbar sits against.
Uses title on the nested ToolbarButtons.

evals.name: slots-and-no-compound
evals.prompt: A property panel deep in the tree should contribute tool options to the toolbar when mode === 'draw'. A teammate wrote <Toolbar.Group slotName='tool-options' /> and a ToolbarSlot outside any provider. Fix it and explain how the slot mechanism works. Reply with code in the answer.
evals.expected_output: Exports are flat siblings, no compound members: ToolbarGroup. Wrap region in ToolbarSlotProvider; ToolbarSlot with matching slotName and order publishes content, renders nothing where it sits; the consuming ToolbarGroup slotName (or ToolbarLayout) shows it ordered ascending by order. Both inside the same provider.
assertions: Uses <ToolbarGroup> instead of the nonexistent <Toolbar.Group> compound member.
Wraps both the ToolbarSlot and the Toolbar in the same ToolbarSlotProvider.
Matches slotName between the ToolbarSlot and the consuming ToolbarGroup.
Says ToolbarSlot renders nothing where it sits and content appears in the consumer ordered ascending by order.

evals.name: icon-font-strings
evals.prompt: A dev passes icon='fa-solid fa-pencil' to ToolbarButton and sees no glyph. Explain why and what to do instead. Reply only.
evals.expected_output: icon is a React node (preferred) or a complete consumer-owned icon-font class string rendered on an <i> unchanged. Components installs no icon font; the product must load the stylesheet and pass every class the font needs. Prefer react-icons nodes or a custom SVG component.
assertions: States that Components installs no icon font.
Says a string icon is rendered on an <i> unchanged so the product must load the font stylesheet and pass every class needed.
Recommends a React node icon such as one from react-icons/fa6 or a custom SVG component.
